_comment: Re-seeding ablation config. Copy to settings_reseed/<target>.json and fill paths. Required: target, target_pdb, baseline_run_dir, checkpoint, autoencoder_path, output_base_dir. baseline_run_dir must be a prior blind generate.py run dir containing scoring_summary.csv (recursively) with a pyrosetta_filter_pass column; its post-filter successes become gen-0 founders AND the RQ1 baseline.
_champion_selection_help: 'uniform' = random winner (spec §7, no pressure); 'ss_stratified' = uniform over a champion_ss_grid x champion_ss_grid helix×sheet grid (uniform SS-space coverage, steers toward under-sampled β).
_redistribute_budget_help: When true, an extinct strain's freed generation budget is spread EVENLY over the surviving strains that round (each gets round(samples_per_cut*n_strains/n_alive) per cut), keeping ~constant folds/round. Deepens real lineages; does not respawn founders; extinction still tracked.
_seed_selection_help: 'random' = residues drawn anywhere on the binder; 'interface' = up to seed_n_res residues drawn ONLY from binder residues within seed_interface_cutoff A of the hotspots (seed_interface_hotspots, else target_hotspot_residues; empty = whole interface). Falls back / skips a strain if fewer than seed_n_res_min interface residues are found.
